picker.title: Book with

rules.acceptingHint: When off, you disappear from the SE list and nobody can book with you (your rules are kept).
rules.authsDesc: Each rule makes meeting types available to a group. Rules add up: anyone matching more than one gets the union of the types. For now only Solution Engineers and admins can access Booking.
rules.authsEmpty: No rules: nobody can book with you.
rules.authsNoTypes: Create at least one meeting type before granting access.
rules.connectHint: You will go to Google's consent screen and come back here. Use your company account.
rules.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect Google Calendar? Nobody can book with you until you connect again. Meetings already created stay on the calendar.
rules.googleDesc: Booking reads your availability and creates the meeting and the blocks directly on your primary calendar. Access is stored encrypted and can be disconnected at any time.
rules.googleNotConnected: Connect your Google account to receive bookings. Without it you can still book with other SEs.
rules.previewLink: See my slots as others see them
rules.subtitle: How others can book meetings on your Google Calendar. Changes apply after you save.
rules.testOk: Connection working: the calendar responded and the time zone was updated.
rules.title: My booking
rules.unsavedConfirm: Your booking rules have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

settings.backupDesc: Importing replaces the rules in the editor as an unsaved change — review and save. Also accepts the backup from the old Apps Script widget.
settings.backupTip: Exports or imports meeting types, access rules and settings.
settings.gapDesc: Time is counted in working minutes only, from the end of one meeting to the start of the next (prep, buffer and follow-up work don't count).
settings.gapReserve: Reserve this gap on the calendar
settings.gapReserveHint: Besides preventing new bookings, creates blocks filling the gap, after all other blocks. They can span days since only working hours count.
settings.gapTip: The checked types must respect the gap AMONG THEMSELVES (including a type with itself). Unchecked types ignore the rule.
settings.importConfirm: Replace the editor's rules with the file's? Nothing is stored until you save.
settings.importDone: File loaded: {{types}} meeting types and {{auths}} access rules. Review and save.
settings.importInvalid: Invalid file: no meeting types found in it.
settings.logTip: Latest operations on your calendar: completed bookings, refusals for lack of space, failures and cleanups. Only you can see it.
settings.onlyNoGuests: Only consider events without other guests
settings.onlyNoGuestsHint: Events with guests other than you keep blocking the calendar, even if the title matches.

ph.Bloco: Current block number (1, 2, 3…) in split prep and multiple holds.
ph.BlocoInfo: Shortcut: becomes " (2/3)" when there is more than one block and empty when there is only one.
ph.DataBloco: Date of the block itself — useful when the prep falls on another day.
ph.DataReuniao: Meeting date (dd/mm/yyyy). In multiple holds, the first slot's date.
ph.HoraBloco: Start time of the block itself (HH:MM).
ph.Itens: Checked items, comma-separated. Empty if none.
ph.Solicitante: Booker's name in Tool Center (or their email if there is no name).
ph.TotalBlocos: Total number of blocks in the set.
ph.Zoho: Zoho link provided. Only shows where you write this placeholder; when empty it becomes "Not provided".

settings.placeholdersHint: Write the placeholder in brackets in the title or description. Case and accents don't matter; an unknown name stays as is, so you notice the typo.

requireFree.day: Only if there is empty, continuous space on the same day
requireFree.week: Only if there is empty, continuous space in the same week

requireFreeHint.day: The event is only ignored if, on the same day and within working hours, there is a fully free interval as long as it.
requireFreeHint.week: Same rule, looking for the space on any working day of the event's week (Sunday to Saturday).

settings.rescheduleHint: Besides booking over it, moves the event to the free space found — only when it actually conflicts with what is being booked.
settings.templatesDesc: The title is required; the description is optional. Use the placeholders listed at the end of this section.
settings.templatesTip: Name and description of each event Booking creates on your calendar.

block.desc: Each slot blocked when the booker holds several to confirm later.
block.name: Held slot (multiple hold)

gap.desc: Only created when the gap rule is set to "reserve on the calendar".
gap.name: Gap between meetings

prepSingle.desc: Used when the prep fits in a single block.
prepSingle.name: Prep — single block

prepSplit.desc: Used when the prep is split into several blocks.
prepSplit.name: Prep — separate blocks

settings.tplDescBlock: Description (optional) — when blank, the block is created without a description.
settings.tplDescMeeting: Description (optional) — when blank, the automatic description is used (type, requester, items, guests and notes).
settings.transparentEmpty: No titles yet. Add the exact title of the events to ignore.
settings.transparentEnableHint: Only events whose title exactly matches the one entered (case and spaces count) are affected.
settings.transparentTip: Makes Booking ignore certain events on your calendar when looking for slots, so meetings can be booked over them. Useful for personal focus or study blocks.

types.bufferEach: Each slot gets its own buffer
types.bufferEachHint: When unchecked, no buffer is created in multiple holds. The pre-meeting block is always created.
types.bufferMinTip: Block placed right AFTER the meeting. If it doesn't fit within working hours, the slot is not offered.
types.bufferSkipAtEnd: Skip the buffer when the meeting ends at the end of working hours
types.bufferSkipAtEndTip: If the meeting ends exactly at closing time the buffer wouldn't fit and the last slot of the day would disappear. With this option it shows up again.
types.defDurTip: Duration preselected when the details screen opens.
types.deleteConfirm: Delete the type "{{name}}"? Access rules will stop granting it.
types.descTip: Supporting text on the type card. Multiple lines allowed.
types.empty: Create a meeting type to get started.
types.fragMaxTip: Maximum size of each block. Each free gap gets at most one fragment.
types.fragMinTip: Minimum size of each block. Smaller gaps are ignored (the final remainder may be shorter).
types.itemsHint: Optional. The maximum duration does not change.
types.itemsTip: Options the booker checks on the details screen. Each checked item ADDS minutes to the type's times.
types.maxAdvanceDTip: How many days ahead bookings are allowed. In DAYS, not minutes.
types.maxBlocksTip: How many slots can be held at once. This is a QUANTITY, not minutes.
types.maxDurTip: Longest possible duration. Never changed by meeting items.
types.meetTip: Automatically adds a Google Meet video call to the event.
types.minDurTip: Shortest duration the booker can pick. Meeting items can increase it.
types.minItemsTip: How many items must be checked at least. This is a QUANTITY, not minutes.
types.minNoticeMinTip: Minimum time between now and the start of the meeting. Closer slots are not offered.
types.multiBlockTip: The booker can block more than one slot to confirm later with a third party. Prep goes BEFORE the first slot and follow-up work AFTER the last one.
types.name: Name
types.nameTip: Name shown on the card the booker picks.
types.noMaxAdvanceTip: Allows booking any future date, ignoring the maximum window.
types.postHint: Reserves time AFTER the meeting (and the buffer), always as close to it as possible, in free gaps within working hours.
types.postMinTip: Total reserved after the meeting. In multiple holds it goes after the LAST slot.
types.postSingleHint: A single block in the first free gap after the meeting.
types.postSplitHint: Splits into several free blocks, always the closest to the meeting.
types.postTip: Time reserved after the meeting to act on what was discussed.
types.preMinTip: Block placed right BEFORE the meeting — highest priority. With consecutive prep the order is: prep, pre-meeting, meeting, buffer.
types.prepConsecHint: A slot is only offered if the prep fits free right before the meeting, within working hours.
types.prepEarliest: In the first free period (closest to today)
types.prepFallback: Reserve the prep even outside the window
types.prepFallbackTip: If there is no free space within the gaps above (for example, an all-day event filling the window), looks for the closest free time instead of refusing the booking.
types.prepGapMax: Maximum gap between prep and meeting (min)
types.prepGapMaxTip: Maximum time, in WORKING minutes, between the end of the prep and the start of the meeting. Keeps the prep from landing too early.
types.prepGapMin: Minimum gap between prep and meeting (min)
types.prepGapMinTip: Minimum time, in WORKING minutes (free or busy), between the end of the prep and the start of the meeting.
types.prepLatest: As close as possible to the meeting
types.prepMinTip: Time reserved on YOUR calendar to prepare. Its position depends on the mode chosen below.
types.prepModeMultiNote: With "Allow holding multiple slots" on, prep cannot be consecutive.
types.prepPlacementTip: Sets where the prep goes between today and the meeting. Does not apply to consecutive mode.
types.prepSingleHint: A single block in any free gap during working hours between today and the meeting.
types.prepSplitHint: Splits the prep into several free blocks during working hours.
types.preSkipAtStart: Skip the pre-meeting block when the meeting starts at the beginning of working hours
types.preSkipAtStartTip: If the meeting starts exactly when working hours begin there is nothing to protect before it — without this option the first slot of the day would never be offered.
types.weekdaysTip: Days this type can be booked. Also applies to prep, buffer and follow-up work.
types.workEndTip: No block is created after this time. The whole window must fit within working hours.
types.workStartTip: No block (prep, meeting, buffer, follow-up) is created before this time.
types.zohoFieldTip: Optional field on the details screen. The link is NOT added to events by default: use the [Zoho] placeholder in Settings › Event titles and descriptions.

zoho.apiVersionTip: Version used for the requests (e.g. v7). Only change it if Zoho retires the current one.
zoho.configured: Zoho CRM integration configured. The scope prompt (Estimates and AE Calculator) now includes the fields below, read from the Zoho link's deal when it is copied. Read-only.
zoho.contactDesc: Contact linked to the deal through a lookup field.
zoho.contactLookup: Deal field that points to the contact
zoho.contactLookupTip: API name of the lookup in the Deals module (default: Contact_Name).
zoho.customDesc: A custom Zoho module linked to the deal.
zoho.customModuleTip: How the module appears in the Zoho API (Settings › Developer Space › APIs › API names).
zoho.dealDesc: Fields of the deal in the Zoho link. Empty fields are grouped on one line ("A, B and C: no value.").
zoho.fieldsLoaded: {{count}} {{module}} fields loaded — pick them by API name in the boxes below.
zoho.linkFieldDealTip: API name of the lookup in the Deals module that points to the custom module record.
zoho.linkFieldSearchTip: API name of the lookup in the custom module that points to the deal.
zoho.linkMode: How the module links to the deal
zoho.linkModeDeal: Field in the deal points to the module
zoho.linkModeSearch: Field in the module points to the deal
zoho.linkModeTip: Either the module record has a lookup pointing to the deal, or the deal has a lookup pointing to the record.
zoho.notConfigured: The Zoho CRM integration is not configured in this environment yet (ZOHO_CLIENT_ID, ZOHO_CLIENT_SECRET and ZOHO_REFRESH_TOKEN variables). You can prepare the fields here; meanwhile the prompt goes out without the Zoho section.
zoho.notConfiguredShort: The Zoho CRM integration is not configured in this environment.
zoho.sectionLabelTip: How the section appears in the prompt (e.g. Deal).
zoho.testDesc: Paste a deal link to see the section exactly as it goes into the prompt, using the settings on this screen (even before saving). Read-only.
